- SOC 2: we have a current SOC 2 Type II (2027) — Kimberly will send a redacted PDF by EOD Jun 22.

Tom / team — Kimberly here, Security & Compliance. Quick summary of artifacts and answers (attached where indicated):

1) SOC 2
- Attached: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (redacted to remove customer names and sensitive ops logs). Coverage: controls testing period Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027.
- Delivery: attached now. If procurement needs additional attestation language we can produce a letter of attestation.

2) SIG/CAIQ
- Attached: SIG_CAIX_answers_pegasus.xlsx — this is a focused export covering network segmentation, auth, key management, and data residency. We flagged any items that require Pegasus-unique architecture decisions.
- ETA: delivered now. Any follow-up Qs please mark with row IDs so we can prioritize.

3) DPA + retention
- We have a standard DPA (link in MAP workbook). Key points for Pegasus:
  * Retention: per-tenant configurable. Default safeties: request logs 30 days, embeddings/audit logs configurable to 90/365/3650 days.
  * 7-year retention: we do support long-term archival for records classified as \"transactional record\" via our archival tier; this requires a signed addendum for storage and additional encryption key handling.
  * Deletion & verification: secure deletion is supported; we can provide hash-based deletion confirmation and periodic deletion reports.
  * Telemetry carveout: our performance telemetry (aggregated metrics and Prometheus-style exporters) is kept separately from PII and is retained for a 90-day window by default. We do not include raw request payloads in telemetry exports.

4) KMS/HSM
- We support customer-managed keys via integrations with major cloud KMS providers and can discuss HSM-backed key policies for Pegasus.

Open items we recommend surfacing in the MAP:
- If Pegasus requires native 7-year retention without an archival addendum, we need legal approval for storage cost & KMS handling.
- Any data residency carveouts (e.g., mandated EU storage) should be flagged now; we support region pinning but there may be lead time for on-premishment.

Attachments included: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf, SIG_CAIX_answers_pegasus.xlsx

Happy to jump on a 30-min call today to walk through any flagged rows.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
